question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Donkey's years
solution:
The correct answer is option 3) i.e. “Long time.”

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Let’s look at the meaning of the given idiom/ phrase: 
 
• The phrase ‘Donkey's years’ means 'for a very long period of time.'
 
• *Example*:
 
 
• *​He has been preparing for job examinations for **donkey's years.***
 
 
 
• Hence, the only possible answer is option 3 ‘Long time’, which exactly resembles the meaning of the given idiom/ phrase.

 

Correct meaning:__ *Long time.*
